name: ripple
title: Ripple
description: Waves spread out from the center and fade, in a loop, with optional content centered above them. Pure CSS keyframes.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `Ripple`. Import it from `@/components/ui/ripple` and render `<Ripple paused={paused} aria-label="Listening" />`.

It loops until you pass `paused`; give users a control that sets it wherever it plays next to other content.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--ripple-surface`, `--ripple-wave`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: opacity only. The waves keep their full size and only pulse.
